Surgical, Dental & Orthopedic Instruments · Manufacturer & Exporter · Sialkot, Pakistan
Opix Instruments is an ISO 13485:2016 certified manufacturer and exporter of German-pattern surgical, dental and
orthopedic instruments, based in Sialkot, Pakistan — the world's surgical instrument capital. Our range covers 9,720
instruments across 28 catalog sections, from scalpel handles and scissors to complete orthopedic, spinal and trauma
instrument sets. Every instrument is forged, milled, heat-treated, hand-assembled and passivated in our own facility, then
inspected against pattern before packing, with full material traceability.
Our quality management system is certified to ISO 13485:2016. The range is CE marked for the European market and
the facility holds a US FDA establishment registration. We are members of the Surgical Instrument Manufacturers
Association of Pakistan (SIMAP) and the Sialkot Chamber of Commerce & Industry (SCCI). Certificates, CE technical
files and material declarations are issued with first orders — and to any buyer who requests them beforehand.
Instruments are manufactured from martensitic stainless steels in the AISI 410, 420 and 440 families, selected by
instrument type, with austenitic 304/316 grades used where corrosion resistance matters more than edge retention.
Tungsten-carbide inserts are fitted on our TC scissor, forceps and needle-holder lines.
We serve importers and distributors, hospitals and surgical centres, OEM / private-label partners and medical device
resellers in more than 40 countries, including the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, the
Netherlands, Poland, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Australia, Canada, Brazil and Turkey. Orders are quoted FOB Karachi or
CIF to the destination port with consolidated export documentation.
Opix runs private-label programmes for distributors and brand owners: your brand name, logo and reference numbers
laser-marked on the instrument, your artwork on the packaging and your catalogue structure applied across the range.
Custom pattern development and tooling are quoted separately.
This catalog presents our orthopedic instrument sets — plating, cannulated screw, intramedullary nailing, spinal fixation,
external fixation and removal systems — each supplied in a sterilization tray, kitted and labelled to your own set list.
Individual references may also be ordered separately. Stocked references typically ship in 2–4 weeks; assembled sets
and private-label runs in 6–10 weeks. Pricing depends on quantity, finish and delivery terms — send us the references
you need and we will return a formal quotation with MOQ and lead time within one working day.
